title: Recipe for Disaster: Freeing the Lumbridge Sage
start: Inspect the Lumbridge Sage in the banquet hall in Lumbridge Castle.
prereq_quests: Recipe for Disaster: Another Cook's Quest

items.t: All of these can be bought from the Culinaromancer's chest.

recommended.t: Wicked hood, skills necklace, or traveller's necklace - to reach the Wizards' Tower

steps.t: Inspect the Lumbridge Sage. [Chat: 1 Yes, I'm sure I can make a cake.]
Head to the floor 3 of the Wizards' Tower and talk to Wizard Traiborn who is west of the beam. [Chat: 1 [Ask about the Lumbridge Sage.]]
Talk to Traiborn again for the first quiz. [Chat: 1 [Ask about the Lumbridge Sage.] › 1 Ok. Let's Start!]
Talk to Traiborn again for the second quiz. [Chat: 1 [Ask about the Lumbridge Sage.] › 1 Ok. I'm ready!]
Talk to Traiborn for the final quiz. [Chat: 1 [Ask about the Lumbridge Sage.] › 1 Quiz me!]
After completing his final quiz, you receive an enchanted egg, a bucket of enchanted milk and pot of enchanted flour.
Use any of the raw ingredients on a cake tin.
Bake the raw guide cake on a range.
Use the cake of guidance on the Lumbridge Sage back in Lumbridge.
